description: This file defines the Java class 'LoanTransactionBalanceWithLoanId', which extends 'LoanTransactionBalance' and adds a 'loanId' property. It is used to represent a loan transaction balance along with its associated loan ID within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanTransactionBalanceWithLoanId
classes.description: A data class representing a loan transaction balance associated with a specific loan ID, extending the base 'LoanTransactionBalance' class.

methods.name: LoanTransactionBalanceWithLoanId
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with transaction type, reversal, manual adjustment, amount, and loan ID.
